mutants.equivalent_reason: web_providers._normalize_host: the translate of U+3002/U+FF0E/U+FF61 to '.' is redundant. Python's idna codec (the next step) already splits labels on exactly those three characters ('bad\u3002org'.encode('idna') == b'bad.org'). The two forms differ only for a host the codec rejects (an empty label such as 'a\u3002\u3002b'), and such a host cannot equal a real block-list entry or a dialable URL host. No input a caller can reach changes the match result.

mutants.equivalent_reason: web_tools._extract: the 16-bytes-per-page slack in the shared byte budget is headroom, not a bound. The guard loop that follows (up to 8 passes, trimming the longest text by the overflow plus 16) restores the only contract, 'whole answer <= MAX_RESULT_BYTES', whichever starting share is used; with the slack removed the output differs from the original only by a few trailing bytes of the longest page's text. test_five_wide_pages_stay_under_the_declared_result_bytes and the full-text footer tests still hold; no assertion on those few bytes would express a requirement.
